text:
maria: Heads-up — cloud partner posted a change to APAC network/egress billing for GPU instances. It's a new egress floor for GPUs in ap-northeast and ap-southeast, effective 2026-05-01. Initial read: ~+12-18% on our unit cost for H100-backed private clusters. :warning:
kevin: Wait — is this just egress (GB) or a per-instance surcharge?
maria: Official note says "GPU-attached egress floor" + revised bandwidth tiers. So it's billed as egress but floor interacts badly with our reserved capacity math.
asha: How much of our committed reserved revenue sits in those regions? If it's material we need packaging changes.
sam: Quick numbers from the ledger: APAC reserved commitments = $1.2M/month (committed), active usage ~72% of that.
ben: If effective unit cost increases 15% on those nodes, our margin on Dedicated customers in APAC drops ~4-6 pts depending on mix (hot vs cold traffic).
oliver: Operationally, we can shift some inference traffic to nearby regions but latency for APAC customers will suffer. Need to quantify SLO impact.
maria: I sketched a ballpark breakpoint.```
apac_reserved_monthly = 1200000
current_unit_cost = 0.045  # $/token-equivalent
new_unit_cost = current_unit_cost * 1.15
monthly_delta = apac_reserved_monthly * (new_unit_cost/current_unit_cost - 1)
print(monthly_delta)  # ~180k
```
kevin: Nice — but remember dedicated costs include fixed infra amortization and reserved discounts. The incremental delta on gross margin will be smaller than raw delta.
ben: Two product options: 1) pass-through the egress component to customers in APAC (add a regional egress surcharge), 2) absorb and adjust tier pricing globally, 3) offer a Hybrid routing SKU that guarantees APAC latency but at higher price.
asha: Preference is to avoid painful surprise to smaller customers. Could we create a new APAC-dedicated SKU for enterprise only and keep small accounts on current pricing until renewal?
sam: Renewal cadence: ~40% of APAC contracts renew in next 90 days. That buys us some runway to redesign packaging.
maria: Short-term asks: (a) eng to produce a delta table breaking down margin impact by customer cohort, (b) pricing to draft 2-3 packaging options, (c) legal/sales to draft messaging for renewals.
kevin: I'll run capacity routing sims tonight — can we move <10% of latency-insensitive workloads to eu-west while staying under SLA? cc @oliver
oliver: I'll validate traces. Early guess: batch/async workloads ~18% of APAC inference could be offloaded without breaking 99p latency for most customers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
billing-bot: Automated note: pulled latest invoice lines for ap-northeast and ap-southeast for last 6 months. Uploaded CSV to finance drive: /shared/finance/apac-egress-raw.csv
ben: Once we have the sim and the invoice CSV, we can estimate per-customer uplift. I'll mock a UI change for the Hybrid SKU to show a regional surcharge preview in self-serve console.
maria: Thanks. Timeline: sims + raw analysis by EOD tomorrow, pricing drafts by EOW. If anything material (>8% margin hit) we plan an emergency pricing workshop next week. :eyes:
asha: Noted. I'll prep messaging options with 3 tiers (absorb, partial-pass-through, enterprise-only).
maria: Great. We'll triage after the EOD run.
